Meitetsu 02

Step-free guide

Platforms1–4

ElevatorエレベーターOne lift, ask staff

Meitetsu’s own barrier-free floor plan shows one lift, on the west (近鉄-transfer) side of the B1F–B2F route, reaching platform 1 — plus an escalator and a ramp elsewhere on the platforms. Staff operate the lift — tell them at the gate, or call 0570-55-0155 in advance.

AThe lift to platform 1
Staff-operated. Ask at the gate, or call 0570-55-0155 in advance.
Allow time
Meitetsu asks for plenty of notice. At busy hours it may not be possible straight away.
Arrive early
Earlier than you would at JR. The platforms are narrow and can be crowded.
Platforms 2–4
Not shown with their own lift on the official diagram — if you need platform 2, 3 or 4, say so when you call ahead so staff can plan the route.
Electric wheelchairs
Handle-type electric wheelchairs are accepted at this station — use the West Gate. Face forward going in, and staff will turn you to exit facing forward too.

Accessible toilet車椅子トイレOne toilet

Meitetsu lists one wheelchair-accessible toilet at this station, with an ostomate fitting and a baby changing shelf.

AThe toilet
Ostomate fitting and baby changing shelf.
Exact position
Not published in text. Illustrated once we have walked it.

Entrances & exits出入口B1F, Hirokoji side

Meitetsu Nagoya is underground (B1F), beneath the Meitetsu Department Store, on the Hirokoji side. From the JR concourse you go down — it is not on the same level.

Gates
Central Gate (中央改札口), North Gate (北改集札口), East and West gates. They all lead to the same island.
From the subway
Exit 12 comes out at the Meitetsu North Gate.
From JR
The Hirokoji Exit (広小路口) is the nearest JR exit.
Coin lockers
Multiple units around the ticket gates.

BoardingのりばRead the door sign

Meitetsu Nagoya has four numbered platforms (1–4) on one underground level. Trains to completely different places can leave from the same platform, one after another.

Platform 1
Gifu, Tsushima and Inuyama.
Platforms 2 & 3
Reserved-car (特別車) boarding only.
Platform 4
Higashi-Okazaki, Toyohashi, Chubu Centrair Airport, Kowa and Utsumi.
Before you board
Read the sign above the door. This is the one thing that goes wrong here.

Help & information案内Service centre

The Meitetsu Nagoya Service Centre is in the station.

Opening hours
Weekdays 10:00–19:00. Weekends and holidays 9:00–18:00.
Assistance
0570-55-0155, or ask staff at the gate.
